positive_findings: Candidate, driver and runner member manifests and outer seals independently verify at the requested exact SHA identities.
Python 3.10 py_compile, bash -n, the driver synthetic self-test and source-candidate validation pass without creating a release, attempt, result or production cycle.
Candidate validation rechecks the frozen M785/M786/M790 chain and the fully sealed M686 40-record and M699 120-record populations.
One-byte mutations of the analyzer, tests, storage oracle, M785 contract, M790 review, M686 manifest and M699 manifest are independently rejected.
Duplicate sealed members, extra partial files, extra symlinks and an altered outer seal are independently rejected by the nested seal verifier.
The replay loop is statically bounded to two separate populations, 40 plus 120 records, ten timesteps and three configurations, with a fresh scheduler per record/timestep.
The common resource is frozen to 96 lanes, 245760 bytes macro-rounded SRAM, Acc24, 3 ns and 192 bytes/cycle; K8 versus equal-service K1x8 is the only named legal pair.
Missing external hashes, startup hooks and an absent true release fail before attempt consumption; result, attempt and release paths remained absent after every dynamic attack.

p1_findings.title: D1 diagnostic cycles enter the emitted headline ratio
p1_findings.evidence: The driver marks module_index==1 rows headline_eligible=false, but per_config.total_cycles accumulates every row and aggregate.typed_k8_vs_equal_service_k1x8 divides those inclusive totals. Thus D1 is labelled nonheadline while numerically changing the population headline ratio.
p1_findings.risk: A released result would contain a ratio inconsistent with the frozen D1 nonheadline boundary and could over- or under-state the paper-facing decoder point.
p1_findings.required_repair: Keep all-config totals for the common charged diagnostic, add independently conserved headline_total_cycles excluding module 1 for both K1x8 and K8, compute the named ratio only from those headline totals, and add a test showing arbitrary D1-cycle perturbations cannot change the headline ratio.

p1_findings.title: Final publication can falsely pass a destination-directory collision
p1_findings.evidence: The runner uses mv -- stage result without -T or a no-clobber primitive. An independent temporary-filesystem attack pre-created result as a directory; GNU mv returned zero, nested stage under result/stage, and both current postconditions (-d result and original stage absent) evaluated true while result/result.json was absent.
p1_findings.risk: A concurrent or injected canonical-path collision can consume the one shot and print success without publishing the sealed result at the canonical root.
p1_findings.required_repair: Use an atomic no-replace publication boundary such as a reviewed lock plus mv -T --no-clobber, and postcheck the canonical root result.json, detailed_rows.json, SHA256SUMS and outer seal. Add a destination-created-after-precheck regression.

p1_findings.title: Runtime release validation does not bind the source hammer to the exact reviewed candidate SHA
p1_findings.evidence: validate_true_release checks only the M795 status, score and severity counts. It does not require the M795 review to name the current candidate SHA, while the release candidate_binding may bind whatever candidate bytes exist at release authoring time.
p1_findings.risk: The source-hammer authority can be replayed across candidate drift; the separate release hammer may catch this operationally, but the executable fail-closed boundary itself does not prove that the launched candidate is the one source-hammered.
p1_findings.required_repair: Require the fresh hammer review to carry and match candidate, driver and runner SHA identities at runtime, and require the true release candidate_binding SHA to equal that exact reviewed candidate SHA.

p2_findings.title: strict_json accepts duplicate object keys
p2_findings.evidence: An independent temporary input {"launch_now":true,"launch_now":false} was accepted as {"launch_now": false}. The parser rejects non-finite constants but does not supply an object_pairs_hook that rejects duplicates.
p2_findings.required_repair: Reject duplicate keys in candidate, release, receipt and result JSON parsing and add adversarial tests for duplicate authorization and canonical-path keys.

p2_findings.title: The sealed M794 request truncates the M699 outer-seal identity
p2_findings.evidence: sealed_production_inputs.m699_outer_seal_file_sha256 in request.json has 58 hexadecimal characters, whereas the frozen candidate carries the verified 64-character eaf975a9a1a4829b2c0a2251e7ef297abd53b83b30e23630e5ce51db5c5de18c identity.
p2_findings.required_repair: Issue an additive corrected request identity with the verified 64-character M699 outer-seal SHA; do not alter the already sealed request.

execution_gate.next_step: Author additive repaired driver, runner and candidate identities, then request a fresh receipt-blind source hammer.
